test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The population of a village was 1,10,000. It increased by 5% in the first year and increased by 25% in the second year. Its population after two years is _______.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Initial Population** = 1,10,000

**First Year** Increase = 5% → Multiplier = 21/20

**Second Year** Increase = 25% → Multiplier = 5/4

**Final Population** = 1,10,000 × (21/20) × (5/4) = 1,10,000 × (105/80) = 1,44,375

**∴ The correct answer is 1,44,375.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial Population (P) = 1,10,000

First year growth rate (R₁) = 5%

Second year growth rate (R₂) = 25%

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/05bf93d990a9832a6cf39fd40775ea2b6d9ea9cbd0ce2c07ee51cc42943daaa6.png] 

**Formula:** Final Population = P × (1 + R₁/100) × (1 + R₂/100)

⇒ Population after 1st year = 1,10,000 + (5% of 1,10,000)

⇒ Population after 1st year = 1,10,000 + 5,500 = 1,15,500

⇒ Population after 2nd year = 1,15,500 + (25% of 1,15,500)

⇒ 25% of 1,15,500 = 1,15,500 ÷ 4 = 28,875

⇒ Final Population = 1,15,500 + 28,875 = 1,44,375

**∴ The correct answer is 1,44,375.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage Change

If a value changes by a% and then by b%, the net effective change is (a + b + ab/100)%.

Population Decrease

If the population decreases, use the formula P × (1 − R/100)ⁿ where R is the rate of decline.

Constant Growth Rate

If the rate R is constant for n years, the population after n years is A = P(1 + R/100)ⁿ.</p
